item.title: Compare Two Places to Change Trains
item.prompt_text: Your friend's first train stops at North End and Hill Street. Either station gives a connection to Cedar Town. The North End change is 12 minutes on the same platform. The Hill Street connection is 25 minutes, with a short walk between platforms. Compare the choices for a friend carrying a heavy bag and say what they should check on the day.
item.audience: a friend planning a journey with one change
item.target_grammar: Comparatives, while for contrast, and if for a conditional recommendation.
item.target_structure: Give the facts for each option, recommend one for this traveller, then add a same-day check.

checklist.point: Make a recommendation that accounts for the bag.
Say what to check before deciding on the day.
